$comment: Declarative suppression list for AI Guard (eslint-plugin-ai-guard) findings.
results from the SARIF before it is uploaded to GitHub Code Scanning. This is
the 'suppress the existing baseline of false positives' step referenced in
.github/workflows/ai-guard.yml. Every entry below is a reviewed false positive;
add new entries only with a justification so the guard stays meaningful.
ignorePathsReason: Test, mock and story files routinely use async test callbacks without await and placeholder credentials; these are fixtures, not shipped code.

ignoreRulePaths.reason: STORAGE_KEYS values (e.g. GEMINI_API_KEY: 'meticai-gemini-key') are localStorage key NAMES, not secret values.
generateLocalText is async by its Promise<string> contract; it chains work via generationChain.then() instead of a literal await.
AIProvider interface methods are async by contract even when a branch returns a static value (e.g. listModels).
AIService interface methods are async by contract; some branches return synchronously to satisfy the uniform signature.
JSON.parse targets the app's OWN first-party fetch bodies it intercepts in direct mode, inside try/catch; not untrusted external network input.
